summary: Self-hosted fitness tracking application for logging workouts, planning routines, and monitoring muscle fatigue and detraining status, with passkey authentication and import capabilities from popular fitness apps.
usecases: Log and track daily workouts including sets, reps, supersets, and cardio.
Import existing workout data from FitNotes, Strong, or Hevy to migrate to a self-hosted server.
Monitor muscle fatigue and detraining status over time to optimize training routines.
ideas: Integrate with wearable devices for automatic rep/set tracking.
Add AI-powered workout recommendations based on fatigue data.
Enable multi-user gym coaching dashboards for trainers.
